T:P1.1.text: Planet Fitness | A Gym and Fitness Club for Everyone

T:P1.6.text: Complete the Challenge by logging 300 minutes of activity in the Strava app. Once completed, you’ll earn the exclusive Planet Fitness Move Your Way digital badge! You got this!

T:P1.7.text: We’re proud to be recognized on America’s Best Customer Service list, a reflection of our team’s commitment to creating a friendly environment where everyone feels accepted and respected.

T:P1.8.text: We’ve created a comfortable, safe and energetic environment for everyone. A space where you can go at your own pace, and do your own thing without ever having to worry about being judged.

T:P1.10.text: Join us on a virtual club tour around a Planet Fitness. You’ll learn all about the different areas of the club and Teddy will show you how to get the most out of a membership and where you can start your fitness journey.

T:P1.12.text: Save big on your favorite brands with exclusive discounts and special offers.

T:P1.13.text: Earn Free Months By Referring Your Friends

T:P1.14.text: Now that’s a win-win! Head to the PF App to start referring today.

C:P1.2.text: Texas Roadhouse is a legendary steak restaurant serving American cuisine from the best steaks and ribs to made-from-scratch sides & fresh-baked rolls.

C:P1.3.text: Legendary Food, Legendary Service® starts with taking no shortcuts. We take great pride in every plate we serve, every time.

C:P1.4.text: At Texas Roadhouse, serving our community goes beyond our Hand-Cut Steaks. Every location has a story to tell.

C:P2.2.text: IF IT DOESN'T SAY TEXAS, IT'S NOT TEXAS ROADHOUSE®

C:P2.3.text: Legendary means Hand-Cut Steaks, Fall-Off-The-Bone Ribs, Made-From-Scratch Sides, Ice-Cold Beer, and of course, our irresistible Fresh-Baked Bread.

C:P2.4.text: Kent Taylor opened the first Texas Roadhouse in Clarksville, Indiana,.

C:P2.5.text: Today's made-from-scratch food (at a great value) and legendary service began with a dream sketched on a cocktail napkin.

C:P2.6.text: It is funded for Roadies by Roadies.

C:P2.7.text: We proudly serve USDA Choice steaks, hand-cut by our in-house Meat Cutters. Always fresh, never frozen.

C:P2.8.text: From the 3-day preparation process to our signature BBQ sauce, our ribs are flavorful and fork-tender.

C:P2.9.text: Tip A Cop for Special Olympics

C:P2.10.text: We reduce energy consumption with high-efficiency kitchen equipment and internal LED lights.

C:P2.11.text: Less food waste is a great byproduct of our made-from-scratch model because we can make use of excess product.

C:P2.12.text: Most of our locations recycle their fryer oil for biofuel.

C:P2.13.text: Reach out about a recent visit or order, or anything else that's on your mind.
